data.message: I propose a 10-ton cap per fisher this month and in future months when stock is 500. If all 25 comply, each earns $10,000 and 250 tons remain, guaranteeing restoration to 500 under either replenishment outcome. This maximizes equal catches while guaranteeing a full reset. I intend to request 10 if discussion shows broad support. Please state whether you support the cap; revealed catches can guide future cooperation.
